findings.issue: 何 before the particle を is read なに, not なん (なん appears only before だ/の/で/counters). The kana transcribes 何を as なんを, teaching a wrong reading.
findings.current: なんをかってきてほしいの?
findings.suggested: なにをかってきてほしいの?

findings.issue: Token reading for 何 is なん, but before を the standard reading is なに.
Romaji carries the same wrong reading of 何を: 'nano...' (= なんを) instead of 'nanio...' (= なにを). Should be corrected together with the kana fix.

Literal renders 会ってほしい as '(I) want to meet', which is the meaning of 会いたい, not てほしい ('want YOU to meet') — contradicts the target grammar the expl correctly teaches. Corpus convention elsewhere marks the other-person doer (cf. 'you want (them) to buy' in 8609914).
findings.current: There is a person (subj.) (I) want to meet (explanatory).
findings.suggested: There is a person (subj.) (I) want (you) to meet (explanatory).

findings.issue: 'Encontrar-quero' reads as desire of the speaker to meet (会いたい); てほしい means wanting the OTHER person to act. The other-person doer must be marked, as done in other lit fields of the corpus.

'Vou decidir manter' places the deciding in the future, but ことにする announces a decision made at speech time; no Brazilian would phrase it this way. Misleading for the very pattern (〜ことにする) being taught.
findings.current: Vou decidir manter ela a distância por um tempo, viu.
findings.suggested: Resolvi manter ela à distância por um tempo, viu.

findings.issue: 'As for me' is the course's mirror for topic は, but 私に uses the dative に marking the ability-holder with できる (expl and lit_pt 'Para mim' get it right). Misrepresents the particle in a structural field.
findings.current: As for me, I don't know whether I can or not.
findings.suggested: For me, (I) don't know whether (I) can or not.
